terra.problem: “Nobody is left standing at the door” overlooks the qualification that the sons and daughters joining the oath are those able to understand.
The statement that the wall work is behind them draws on an event outside this passage without a reference.
The statement that Persia was the empire ruling over them is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
“It's in the wrong batch” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer.
The explanation says swapping goods is also prohibited, but the text says they will not buy from the sellers. It does not address trading.
